summary: BlackSky Technology Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. and Craig-Hallum Capital Group LLC as sales agents for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $250 million of Class A common stock. The shares may be sold from time to time at market prices on the NYSE or in negotiated/block transactions under Rule 415(a)(4). The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown via ATM facility, not a special situation. No premium, valuation, or board recommendation is involved. The company is not obligated to sell any shares, and either party may terminate on 10 days' notice.
